1.description: Could not return results. The API doesn't have enough questions for your query. (Ex. Asking for 50 Questions in a Category that only has 20.)

2.description: Contains an invalid parameter. Arguments passed in aren't valid. (Ex. Amount = Five)

4.description: Session Token has returned all possible questions for the specified query. Resetting the Token is necessary.

5.description: Too many requests have occurred. Each IP can only access the API once every 5 seconds.
